purpose: Distinct illustrative editorial photographs for the Meluvya guide library.

licenseReview.notes: Pexels permits free website/blog use and modification. Photographer credits link to each source. These are illustrative stock photos, not Meluvya outputs, endorsements, or technique tests.

processing: Auto-orient, convert to sRGB WebP, strip metadata, and resize without upscaling. Masters have a 3840-pixel long edge; responsive derivatives use widths 480, 960, and 1600. No generative edits.
